messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we sketched a bunch of fixes but we need a concise action list to update the runbook and the hotpatch playbook. Main goal: make triage steps deterministic so oncall can follow a checklist without guessing.

mira: Agree. I'll draft the triage checklist edits. Proposal: split into 'P0: immediate mitigation' vs 'P1: monitor + schedule fix'. Keep P0 to 3 steps max.

devin: +1. Also please include the exact kubectl/ops commands we used during the event; saved a few minutes.

alex: Good call. Add command snippets and expected outputs. Here are the ones we ran in the incident:
```
# cordon + drain the noisy node quickly
kubectl cordon node-24
kubectl drain node-24 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
# nuke backlog pods for the inference workers
kubectl delete pod -l app=inference-worker -n redwood
```

mira: I'll include that. Also adding an 'If OOM' branch that recommends switching to the quantized fallback model 'rwd-medium-q4' and reducing batch_size to 1.

samir: For owners and timelines: mira -> triage checklist update (due 2026-04-05); devin -> hotpatch script + tests (due 2026-04-09); jules -> escalation matrix & pager rotation update (due 2026-04-06). I'll be the coordinator for verification.

jules: I'll verify escalation levels and rotations. Suggestion: clarify infra vs ml-sre paging threshold (30 minutes?).

alex: Set infra page at 30m if mitigation not applied; tab that in the runbook. Also add 'automatic fallback' step for canary rollouts and a one-click rollback snippet.

mira: Drafted runbook PR: https://git.company/redwood/runbooks/pull/142 — contains the checklist, command snippets, and the decision tree. Please review comments inline.

devin: I'll add a smoke-check to CI for the hotpatch script and a dry-run option. Pre-flight command suggestion:
```
./tools/hotpatch --dry-run --cluster prod
```
I'll include expected output samples.

oncall-bot: Reminder: triage owner assignment template is now in the workspace. Use `/assign-triage` to claim the P0 owner.

alex: Action items — please update the incident tracker with JIRA links for each action. We'll do a 30-minute sync next Tue at 10:00 PT to close PRs or reassign.

mira: Ack, will post checklist and mark any blockers. :thumbsup:

samir: One technical note — recurring pattern correlates with GC spikes during batch ingest. Recommend adding an alert: `heap.alloc > 2GB for 5m AND batch_queue_length > 50` so we detect earlier.

jules: Will add the alert and a playbook snippet for graceful drain that helps avoid mass evictions. Also adding a small KB note on expected pod restart behavior.

alex: Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll mark these as 'runbook-action' in the tracker and close the loop once PRs merge.
